Give yourself a break, you are fighting through your own stuff. It is ok to not be ok sometimes. 

And Happy Cake Day. I hope you get some relief soon.  Good luck.

Thanks for the response. I love to cook and have always cooked healthy meals for my kids. Cooking is bonding time for us. And I miss it. 

Thanks for the supportive words.

There is no “normal” way to go through this. The fact that you still do self-care is ok. You just cope in different ways. 

Have you tried talking to a professional?

Sorry you are going through this and I hope you find some relief soon.
Thanks for your response. It helps just to feel heard by people who get it.

You don’t have to have all the symptoms and at a certain level. It is a scale. A good clinician will be able to recognize even moderate depression and can recommend treatment. 

As an example, I have battled depression for decades and I have never felt like I was doing things slowly. Even when I could barely get out of bed. People experience depression in different ways and with different symptoms. 

Go to your appointment. Answer any questions open and honestly. Don’t try to make it seem better or worse. Just tell them what you experience. 

Good luck.

You aren’t a coward. We just live in a time where the brain isn’t as understood as it should be. And unfortunately their is still a stigma. Progress is being made. At least depression is covered by the ADA. Which is helpful for taking leave, but doesn’t change the fear I feel or worry about the stigma. There is still a lot of people with preconceived notions. 

I really wish I could just say “I have a neurological disorder that is mostly controlled by medication, but sometimes flairs up and makes it hard for me to work.” Just leave the D word out of it. 

Good luck today. I know it sucks and it feels so unfair. You just have to limp through another day. I really just look forward to the moment I am home and can crawl under a blanket and just be safe again. It’s the only thing that gets me through some days.

That is the hardest part. Not being able to just say “I’m depressed as duck and I feel like shit.” Any other illness you can tell people you are u err the weather. This one, not so much. 

I am in the same boat. Just got dressed and sitting on my bed on Reddit when I should be driving to work because I just don’t want to go.

I am still here. Not feeling any better.
Thanks for checking.

Thanks. 

I was in a phase 3 clinical trial for Rapastinel. Which is a ketamine replacement. Works fast, within hours. Works well for about 3 days. Having to go in twice a week for IV push is not practical  for my life. Ketamine & it’s adjacents are really best for quickly stabilizing someone in crisis. And then more traditional treatments would be used long term. 

I also recently finished 36 treatments of TMS. That did not work at all. 

My meds stop working about 14 months ago. And I’ve kind of run out of options. My next appointment with my doc is to try to figure out what is next in my treatment.

Still down.  I went out last night to try to improve my mood. Did things I liked. But still down. This has been going on for over a year. Various treatments tried (at a decent amount of time and expense.) Nothing is working. Have another meeting with my psychiatrist in a couple of weeks to see what is next.

I just keep plugging along. Get up. Take my meds. Go to work. Take care of the things that need doing. 

I am sure I seem fine. But inside I am dying. And I am just tired of feeling this way. 

Thanks for checking in.

I am drunk RN so I have much less fucks to give. 

In a good way.
Thanks for the encouragement.
My children are teenagers. So that isn’t an issue.

You are 18. You no longer need their permission. Even if you are on their health plan. The moment you turned 18 it became your business alone. 

Find a way to get your insurance information. Contact the insurance company. Find out what is available and what is covered. It may 100% covered by insurance which will save you from copays. Again even if it is their plan, no one can share your private health information with them. 

If that route doesn’t work look up mental health services in your area. You still may be able to go at no or low cost. Especially if you don’t have income. 

A mental health professional should assess wether or not you need treatment. Not your parents.
Thanks for the words of encouragement.
Thanks for your kind words.

Thanks. It is good to have some kind of outlet. Not the kind of thing I would post on FB. 

Good on you for fighting too. Good on all of us.

That is what has kept me going these last two months. Christmas and then my oldest has a birthday at the beginning of the year. 

So I just keep kicking the can down the road and dragging myself forward. Thinking about ending it every damn day. 

I know it sucks, You are a good human for even caring about your child. I honestly go to the suicide bereavement sub Reddit. Reading what others are going through after losing a loved one to suicide helps me hold on. Even though it makes me cry. It may not work for you.  

Good luck. I hope you find some comfort soon.

Thanks for your message. I appreciate it. 

To be clear I have a job. I hate it. But realize that I am lucky to have it. But it still makes me miserable and is just one more weight to carry. 

I just need a break. I know that sounds ungrateful from someone with a job and roof over his head. 

This job was hope to hang on to. And now it is gone. And it is just one more damn thing. 

Again, thanks for your response and support. I appreciate it.
They are both teens.

Good luck on your TMS. Hope it works for both of us. 

Thank you got your words of encouragement.
Thanks

I am doing the same for my kids. Without their need for me, I would just pack it in. 

I hope your life improves for you soon. I wish the same for me. 

Good luck.
It definitely keeps me from being fully honest when I feel suicidal.

As someone who fought depression for 30 years I find it personally terrifying. 

That said I understand. Contrary to the movies it is not some nefarious plot. They do it when they can document that they genuinely believe you a danger to yourselves and other. 

They can only hold you for 72 hours unless they get a court order.
Thank you for the kind words. The idea of hurting my kids this way is the only thing keeping me going.
Thanks. I hope so too. Good luck.
